1.title: Introduction to CSS
1.explanation: CSS (Cascading Style Sheets) is used to style HTML pages. It controls colors, fonts, spacing, layouts, and animations.
1.output: The webpage has a light gray background, dark text, and a blue heading.
1.practice: Change the background color and make all headings green.

2.title: Selectors
2.explanation: Selectors tell CSS which HTML elements to style.
2.output: Headings become red, paragraphs are larger, and elements with class 'button' have a blue background.
2.practice: Style a heading, a paragraph, and create a button class.
2.quiz: Which selector targets all paragraph elements?
